# Per-module JVM line-coverage floors: # Floors are set from the default `./gradlew build` configuration
# unless Docker / the integration flag is available
# jobs in CI can only raise these numbers. Each floor sits a few points under the
# measured value to absorb environment noise
# `integration` marks a module whose contracts only run with Docker: its floor is
# reported but not enforced unless `-Ptanseki.runIntegrationTests=true` is passed
# (the CI integration jobs do). The floor is deliberately low for those — its job
# is to catch "the container suite silently did not run" (which measures 0%)
# to claim a coverage level nobody has measured yet.
#   - every JVM module with `src/main/kotlin` needs exactly one row; a missing row
#     or a row for a module that reports nothing both fail the gate;
#   - raise a floor only together with the tests that earn it;
#   - lowering a floor is a deliberate decision and must be called out in review;
